card.name: Words introducing a recommended limit or range
card.fires_on: The last word of a phrase that names a limit, range, or target amount (e.g. "tolerable limit", "therapeutic range", "recommended intake"), just before the numeric value is given.

modes.label: Limit/range noun
modes.description: A noun such as limit, range, levels, intake or target that completes a phrase about acceptable amounts, right before the figure.
modes.example: The DRI suggests an upper tolerable<< limit>> between 10–30 mg

modes.label: Recommended-standard phrase
modes.description: A closing parenthesis or adjective in a phrase about an agency's recommended limit, where a threshold value comes next.
modes.example: The WHO and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA<<)>> recommended limit for arsenic in drinking water

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like maximum, minimum, threshold and upper limit, which anticipates a stated cutoff value.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to state a limit, range or target amount, such as a safe upper level.
